tara: Heads-up onboarding heron48k-int4 (48k ctx). After a long prefill and purposely evicting a KV shard mid-generation we see nondeterministic token drift + regen NLL regression.

sachin: Can you paste a minimal repro?

tara: Repro (deterministic):
```bash
./eval-runner --model heron48k-int4 --seed 77 --prompt-file tests/longstream_48k.txt --prefill 46000 --evict-at-token 1234 --max-toks 200
```

tara: Short log snip showing the discontinuity after stitch: 
```text
[2026-03-27T11:02:01Z] kv_shard=11 kv_pos=65535 ropescale=1.00009
[2026-03-27T11:02:01Z] kv_shard=12 kv_pos=0     ropescale=0.99952  <-- jump at shard boundary after restore
[2026-03-27T11:02:02Z] token_delta=0.34 nll_increase=+15.1%
```

marta: I can repro in the sim harness. Bisect points to the int4 fused ropescale recompute path during kv_restore. int8 path clean.

tara: Disabling prefix cache eliminates the drift, so restore/stitch is implicated.

sachin: Hypothesis: when shards are restored we recompute per-shard rotary multipliers from quantized accumulators and a local offset. Small per-shard rounding and differing accumulation orders over large contexts (~48k) produce multiplicative mismatch across shard boundaries; the stitch assumes identical ropescale.

marta: Proposed mitigation: add "stitch_rescale" during kv_restore. Compute a canonical ropescale from the first restored block (or a running reference) and apply a multiplicative correction when copying keys from subsequent shards. Add a unit/integration test that asserts post-restore token sequence identical within 1e-4 for int4 path.

tara: Dropped a tiny reproducer unit test tests/unit/test_kvcache_stitch_rescale.py and a draft PR #5129: "kv: stitch_rescale on restore to align rotary multipliers across shards (int4 fused path)".

ci-bot: canary/heron reported regen-drift > threshold at 2026-03-27T11:05:00Z; canary paused.

sachin: Can we run a quick smoke (5 seeds) patched vs unpatched on GPU before backport? Prefer real GPU (p4d) to catch perf/FP differences.

marta: Running smoke now. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/smoke_longprefill.sh --model heron48k-int4 --pr 5129 --seeds 77 78 79 80 81 --prefill 47000 --evict-at 512 --out /tmp/heron-smoke-3177777777
```

marta: Early results: patched run ropescale diffs under 3e-5, regen NLL returned to baseline within noise. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/heron48k/3177777777/smoke_logs.tar.gz

tara: Great. Next steps: (1) full 20-seed eval on stage dedicated, (2) backport runtime fix for int4 fused kernels, (3) add onboarding gate to fail models with >1% regen drift for prefill+evict cases, (4) add integration check to nightly longprefill smoke.

sachin: I'll review PR and add the CI gate. Also add a monitoring alert to flag any future canaries with prefill+evict pattern so we fail fast.

deploy-bot: Canary create request queued for heron48k-int4 with PR #5129.

tara: Thanks all 10. Will follow up with full eval artifacts.
